text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
list I1, which must be performed on yearly
bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
above title block.
This pump is used to transfer the water from the 
back wash collection sump to the waste collection sump.
Technical Specifications:
Neutralization 
 pit pump | P-109A/B
Manufacturer | Garbarino
Model &Type | MU 80-250A Horizontal 
 Centrifugal 
 Pump
Number
 of Stages | 1
Speed | 1450 RPM CW
Liquid Handled | Fresh water containing 5 % H2SO4
 and 5-6 % NaOH (ph 4- 14)
Capacity | 100 M/H
Head | 2100 M
NPSH | 2.6 M
Motor Power | 11
 kw
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed 
El-henawy, 
reviewed by eng. Hossam El-Din Mostafa, accepted by eng. Magdy Okba, revised by 
MDEPC 
quality control 
eng. Magdy Hegazy, and approved by eng

manager & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor
Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning 
 fluid, manual 
 puller.
Feeler gauge, 
 dial 
 indicator
Vibrometer, straight edge, 
 rags.
Work to be carried out
Pump in operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and 
 power .
Check the noise of the 
 pump.
Measure vibration level for 
 bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine 
 what to do
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the 
 mechanical seal and piping leak .
Pump out of operation
Check alignment and adjust if 
 needed
Check the fixation
Starting 
 the Pump
Before starting the pump, the 
 following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation 
 of motor before starting; it is clockwise
Check 
 the oil level in the oiler
Filling 
 the pump casing with the liquid
Attendance and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be 
checked:
Check of flow rate and delivery 
 head
Check 
 the mechanical seal for leaks
Check that
 the current absorbed by the motor does not exceed 
 the rated value shown on the name plate
Check the pump pressure
